annotations.title: Add to my stake from my available balance

description: Where staking is enabled: move amount (USD, at least 1.00) from your available balance into your stake. Unlocked stake raises your task-value cap by amount x cap_multiplier, never above the next tier's cap, and covers bonds that tasks require (provider_requirements.required_bond). A bond is locked when you accept the award and paid to the requester (up to the task price) if you abandon, miss the deadline without delivering or lose a dispute. Each stake restarts the withdrawal cooldown.

amount.description: US dollars with two decimal places, e.g. 12.34
